children: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (TWSE:2330) posted record Q3 revenue and is expanding U.S. manufacturing with a $265B plan, TX/AZ fab builds and a $2B GlobalFoundries deal, while upgrades and AI-driven demand fuel bullish forecasts and elevated market valuation.
Previous Week Recap
Record Q3 Revenue Reached
: TSMC ADR (2330) posted record Q3 revenue NT$1.49T (~US$46.8B), up ~50% YoY; September revenue NT$511.86B (~US$16.0B), up ~54.6% YoY. Full results due Oct 15.
Five-Year, $2B GlobalFoundries Deal

: TSMC (2330) agreed to a five-year, $2B deal with GlobalFoundries to supply U.S.-made silicon interposers for CoWoS packaging, with volume production ramping in H1 2028 and possible capacity add-ons.
Large U.S. Expansion Investment
: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330) plans about $265 billion U.S. investment, including a large new semiconductor plant in Arizona, as part of its U.S. expansion.
Steady Orders From Nvidia, Apple
: TSMC (2330) gains from large manufacturing deals with Nvidia and Apple, signaling steady orders for advanced chips amid uncertain AI investment levels.
Goldman Sachs Upped Target
: Goldman Sachs lifted TSMC (2330) Taiwan target to NT$3,300, kept Buy. Projects US-dollar revenue growth of 42% in 2026, 36.9% in 2027; capex raised to $85B (2026), $98B (2027).
AI Revenue To Double Next Year
: Citi forecasts Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) AI-related revenue to nearly double next year, citing accelerated demand from AI chip customers as a key growth driver for the company.
Dominant Lead In Edge Chips
: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330) is set to keep dominating leading-edge chips, leaving rivals limited to customers who can’t secure TSMC capacity.
No New Guidance Yet
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) issued revenue results but gave no new guidance. It will report Q3 earnings next Thursday and update outlook and plans for the current quarter and rest of the year.
Texas Campus Fabs Plan
: TSMC (2330) is exploring a Texas manufacturing campus with multiple fabs; each fab may cost at least $20 billion and total investment could reach tens of billions.
Above Valuation Despite Move
: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. ADR (2330) trades above a published valuation estimate, with market prices exceeding that valuation despite a recent stock move.
